name: Allies
summary: Mortals who support and help you voluntarily, though they have their own concerns and limits.
ratingGuide: One dot: one ally of moderate influence and power
Two dots: two allies, both of moderate power
Three dots: three allies, one of whom is quite influential
Four dots: four allies, one of whom is very influential
Five dots: five allies, one of whom is extremely influential

name: Alternate Identity
summary: A complete second identity with papers, records, and a believable cover life.
ratingGuide: One dot: new identity, easy to slip out of character
Two dots: convincing enough for skilled professional covers
Three dots: recognized reputation in the infiltrated area
Four dots: trusted and respected within the cover sphere
Five dots: commands respect and may include real influence

name: Contacts
summary: Information sources across the city, from major experts to minor bureaucrats and hangers-on.
ratingGuide: One dot: one major contact
Two dots: two major contacts
Three dots: three major contacts
Four dots: four major contacts
Five dots: five major contacts

name: Domain
summary: Recognized feeding territory whose size and security can be shaped to suit the chronicle.
ratingGuide: One dot: a single small building, enough for a basic haven
Two dots: a large structure with controllable access
Three dots: a high-rise, city block, or major intersection
Four dots: a defensible enclave or protected access zone
Five dots: an entire neighborhood or suburb

name: Fame
summary: Recognition in mortal society that opens doors, complicates hunting, and attracts attention.
ratingGuide: One dot: known to a select subculture
Two dots: a minor celebrity recognized by random people
Three dots: notable renown, such as a senator or established entertainer
Four dots: a full celebrity recognized by the average person
Five dots: a household name

name: Generation
summary: Purity of blood and proximity to the First Vampire, shaping blood pool and per-turn expenditure.
ratingGuide: One dot: Twelfth Generation, 11 blood pool, spend 1 blood per turn
Two dots: Eleventh Generation, 12 blood pool, spend 1 blood per turn
Three dots: Tenth Generation, 13 blood pool, spend 1 blood per turn
Four dots: Ninth Generation, 14 blood pool, spend 2 blood per turn
Five dots: Eighth Generation, 15 blood pool, spend 3 blood per turn

name: Herd
summary: A stable group of mortals from whom you can feed without immediate fear of exposure.
ratingGuide: One dot: three vessels
Two dots: seven vessels
Three dots: 15 vessels
Four dots: 30 vessels
Five dots: 60 vessels

name: Influence
summary: Pull in mortal institutions, especially police and bureaucracy, able to sway policy and access.
ratingGuide: One dot: moderately influential, a factor in city politics
Two dots: well-connected, a force in state politics
Three dots: influential position in regional politics
Four dots: broad personal power in national politics
Five dots: a factor in global politics

name: Mentor
summary: A Kindred patron or group that offers guidance, warning, and occasional leverage.
ratingGuide: One dot: an ancilla of little influence, or a Ductus or Pack Priest
Two dots: a respected elder or decorated veteran
Three dots: a heavily influential mentor such as Primogen or Bishop
Four dots: city-shaping power such as Prince or Archbishop
Five dots: extraordinary power such as Justicar or Cardinal

name: Resources
summary: Money, assets, holdings, and access to a standard of living suited to your station.
ratingGuide: One dot: sufficient working-class stability
Two dots: moderate middle-class comfort with occasional indulgence
Three dots: comfortable and established with land, credit, and long-term stability
Four dots: wealthy, mostly in durable assets rather than ready cash
Five dots: extremely wealthy with vast, distributed assets and high-end mobility

name: Retainers
summary: Servants, assistants, ghouls, or other loyal helpers who support your unlife directly.
ratingGuide: One dot: one retainer
Two dots: two retainers
Three dots: three retainers
Four dots: four retainers
Five dots: five retainers

name: Status
summary: Standing and reputation in local Kindred society, shaped by Sect and lineage as much as deed.
ratingGuide: One dot: known, such as a neonate or Pack Priest
Two dots: respected, such as an ancilla or Ductus
Three dots: influential, such as an elder or Templar
Four dots: powerful, such as Primogen or Bishop
Five dots: luminary, such as Prince or Archbishop
